answer_1.quote: In recent times, significant achievements have been made by large-scale language models in generative tasks involving such as multiple speaker speech syntheses , music generation , and audio generation.
answer_1.outputs: discrete codec representations for speech and audio generation

answer_2.quote: For objective evaluation of our codec models, we employ the UTMOS automatic Mean Opinion Score (MOS) prediction system. UTMOS can yield scores highly correlated with human evaluations... we also adopt the metrics from speech enhancement fields, such as the PESQ , STOI, and the F1 score for voiced/unvoiced classification (V/UV F1)... For assessing speaker similarity (SPK)... we employ WavLM-TDNN... we conduct ASR on the generated audio and calculate the word error rate (WER).

answer_4.quote: We conduct the MOS (mean opinion score) evaluation on the Librispeech test set to measure the audio naturalness via crowdsourcing in zero-shot TTS experiments.
answer_4.guideline: We keep the text content and prompt speech consistent among different models and ask human raters to evaluate audio naturalness.
